headline: Ordinances to repeal bans on camping and on campers and RVs on public property, plus a request to buy City-owned parcels.
summary: Both ordinances were tabled at the 4/22/26 meeting. A communication from John Flatley Company asks to buy City-owned parcels.
items: Request from John Flatley Company to buy City-owned parcels
O-26-004: repeal ban on camping on public property
O-26-005: repeal ban on campers and recreational vehicles on public property
Petition for L Deerwood Drive, Lot H-103
